title: Jailbreak Detection with Cheaper Probes: PCA-Reduced Activations vs. Full Hidden States

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Making probes cheaper and faster enables deployment in latency-sensitive production systems. PCA directions also aid interpretability. Directly addresses the practical deployment barrier for activation-based detection.
